0022600180.text: The Cavaliers (4-3, 3-1 at home but 1-2 on the road) come in on a one-game losing streak, second in the Central and two games back, while the Thunder (5-2, 3-0 at home) are coming off a win and sit 0.5 games back in the Northwest. Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness), and Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The Thunder lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 117-112 win in Cleveland, and the Cavaliers lost both meetings in 2025-26.
